name: Apply SQL Migrations
description: Decodes the uploaded tgz inside the postgres LXC, applies the bootstrap/db/*.sql files to the app's database. Uses a per-app bookkeeping table <slug>_data._proxvex_migrations (filename PK, sha256) so re-runs and upgrades only apply pending files. Framework-core SQL (00_roles, 01_auth_schema, 02_provisioning) is auto-skipped when the auth schema already exists, so multi-app installations share one auth setup.
